import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    tr_idx, te_idx = train.split_idx(df, seed)
    tr_df = df.iloc[tr_idx].copy()
    te_df = df.iloc[te_idx].copy()
    global_mean = tr_df[train.TARGET].mean()
    mapping = tr_df.groupby(train.PATIENT)[train.TARGET].mean()
    tr_df[train.HIST] = tr_df[train.PATIENT].map(mapping)
    te_df[train.HIST] = te_df[train.PATIENT].map(mapping).fillna(global_mean)
    f = train.feats(tr_df)
    Xtr = tr_df[f].to_numpy()
    ytr = tr_df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    Xte = te_df[f].to_numpy()
    yte = te_df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(Xtr, ytr, Xte, seed)
    return (yte, y_pred)
patches.fix_B:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    data = train.add_history(df)
    patients = data[train.PATIENT].unique()
    tr_pat, te_pat = train_test_split(patients, test_size=0.25, random_state=seed)
    tr_mask = data[train.PATIENT].isin(tr_pat).to_numpy()
    te_mask = data[train.PATIENT].isin(te_pat).to_numpy()
    f = train.feats(data)
    X = data[f].to_numpy()
    y = data[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(X[tr_mask], y[tr_mask], X[te_mask], seed)
    return (y[te_mask], y_pred)
